evals.name: routing-triggers
evals.prompt: my CLAUDE.md is 900 lines and half of it is out of date, can you sort it out
evals.expected_output: claudemd-compact loads and compacts/de-stales the CLAUDE.md hierarchy, splitting detail into references and dropping rules the repo already enforces.

evals.name: routing-excludes-claudemd-patch
evals.prompt: add my usual test-writing policy block to this project's CLAUDE.md
evals.expected_output: Inserting the maintainer's standard reusable rule blocks is claudemd-patch's job; claudemd-compact must not load, because it reorganizes what is there rather than adding the standard blocks.
